transcript:
Speaker A (Om Prakash): Society ke log mujhe guard uncle bolte the. Ab unke bacche mujhse kehte hain, 'Uncle, aap toh angrezi mein baat karte ho! Corporate mein naukri kaise lagi?' [People in the society used to call me guard uncle. Now their kids ask me, 'Uncle, you speak in English! How did you get a corporate job?']
Speaker B (Narrator): Yeh kahani hai Om Prakash ki. 55 saal ke hain. Lucknow mein ek residential society mein raat ka chowkidar hai. Raat 10 baje se subah 6 baje, 8 ghante. Salary ₹8,000. Biwi hai, ek beti hai 22 saal ki, ek beta hai 17 saal ka. Beti ki shaadi ki umar ho gayi hai. Rishte aa rahe hain par Om Prakash ke paas ₹2 lakh ka intezaam nahi hai. Biwi kehti hai... [This is the story of Om Prakash. He is 55 years old. He is a night watchman in a residential society in Lucknow. 10 PM to 6 AM, 8 hours. Salary ₹8,000. He has a wife, a 22-year-old daughter, and a 17-year-old son. His daughter is of marriageable age. Proposals are coming but Om Prakash doesn't have ₹2 lakhs arranged. His wife says...]
Speaker C (Wife): Kuch karo! Ladki ki umar nikal rahi hai. Log poochte hain kitna doge, main kya bolu? [Do something! The girl is aging. People ask how much we will give, what do I say?]
Speaker B (Narrator): Om Prakash ne koshish ki. Doosri jagah naukri dhoondhi. Hotel mein gaya, bole angrezi aani chahiye. Mall mein gaya, bole angrezi mein baat karni padegi customers se. Corporate park mein security supervisor ki vacancy thi, salary ₹25,000, par interview angrezi mein tha. Om Prakash gaya. Interviewer ne poocha... [Om Prakash tried. He looked for a job elsewhere. Went to a hotel, they said English is required. Went to a mall, they said you must talk to customers in English. There was a security supervisor vacancy in a corporate park, salary ₹25,000, but the interview was in English. Om Prakash went. The interviewer asked...]
Speaker D (Interviewer): Can you maintain a visitor log and coordinate with the admin team?
Speaker B (Narrator): Om Prakash chup. Reject. Har jagah ek hi jawab—angrezi nahi aati toh ₹8,000 ki naukri karo. Angrezi aati hai toh ₹25,000 ki. Raat ko duty par baithta tha, society sunsaan. Kabhi-kabhi koi car guzarti, kabhi kutta bhaunkta. Baaki 8 ghante khaali. Phone mein puraane gaane sunkar waqt kaat-ta tha. Ek raat society ke flat number 302 ka ladka Rohit, college mein hai, neeche aaya. Rohit... [Om Prakash was silent. Rejected. Everywhere the same answer—if you don't know English, do an ₹8,000 job. If you know English, a ₹25,000 one. He sat on duty at night, the society was deserted. Sometimes a car passed, sometimes a dog barked. The remaining 8 hours were empty. He passed time listening to old songs on his phone. One night, Rohit, a college boy from flat 302, came down. Rohit...]
Speaker E (Rohit): Uncle, neend nahi aa rahi. Baithta hoon thodi der. [Uncle, I can't sleep. I'll sit for a while.]
Speaker B (Narrator): Baithkar baatein karne lage. Om Prakash ne apna dukh bataya. Beti ki shaadi, paisa nahi hai, acchi naukri nahi milti. Rohit bola... [They sat and talked. Om Prakash shared his grief. Daughter's wedding, no money, can't get a good job. Rohit said...]
Speaker E (Rohit): Uncle, aapko pata hai corporate mein security supervisor ki salary kitni hai? [Uncle, do you know what a corporate security supervisor's salary is?]
Speaker A (Om Prakash): Haan pata hai beta, ₹25,000. Par interview angrezi mein hota hai, mujhe angrezi nahi aati. [Yes I know son, ₹25,000. But the interview is in English, I don't know English.]
Speaker E (Rohit): Uncle, aap roz 8 ghante yahan baithe rehte ho khaali. Yeh 8 ghante mein angrezi seekh sakte ho. English Seekho app download karo. Hindi mein samjhaya hai sab. Padhna nahi hai, sirf video dekhna hai, sunna hai. Aapke paas phone hai na? [Uncle, you sit here empty for 8 hours daily. You can learn English in these 8 hours. Download the English Seekho app. Everything is explained in Hindi. No reading, just watch videos and listen. You have a phone, right?]
Speaker A (Om Prakash): Haan hai par beta, 55 saal ka hoon. Ab angrezi? [Yes I have, but son, I am 55. Now English?]
Speaker E (Rohit): Uncle, 55 saal ke ho, 8 ghante free ho. Yeh combination kisi ke paas nahi hota. Students ke paas bhi itna time nahi hota. Aapke paas hai, use karo. [Uncle, you are 55 and have 8 hours free. Nobody has this combination. Even students don't have this much time. You have it, use it.]
Speaker B (Narrator): Om Prakash ne socha, beti ka chehra yaad aaya, download kar liya. Us raat duty par baithe-baithe English Seekho app khola. General English show khola, hello se shuru kiya. Video ek lakh log dekh chuke hain. Hindi mein samjhaya tha. 'My name is Om Prakash. I work as a security guard.' Itna bola pehli baar. Doosri raat roz ke 10 easy sentences dekhe—'Good morning sir', 'How can I help you?', 'Please sign the register', 'Your cab is waiting', 'May I see your ID, please?'. Yeh sab security guard ke kaam ke sentences the. Teesri raat good manners ke English words dekhe—'Welcome sir', 'Have a good day', 'Please wait, I will check', 'Thank you for visiting'. Ab roz raat ki duty ka routine badal gaya. 10 se 12 English Seekho app se video dekho. 12 se 2 AI Coach se practice karo. 2 se 4 jo seekha woh gate par aane waale logon par try karo. 4 se 6 society ka round lagao. AI Coach se roz baat karta tha, 24 ghante available hai. Bola, 'Corporate mein security supervisor ka interview hai, kya poochenge?' AI Coach ne sikha diya—'I have 10 years of experience in security. I can manage visitor logs, coordinate with the admin team, and handle emergency situations. I am comfortable communicating in English with residents and guests.' Ek-ek line practice ki. 500 baar galat bola, 500 baar sudhara. Kabhi nahi bole 55 saal ka hai, tujhse nahi hoga. Pehle hafte gate par aane waale delivery boy ko bola... [Om Prakash thought, remembered his daughter's face, and downloaded it. That night on duty, he opened the English Seekho app. Opened the General English show, started with hello. One lakh people had watched the video. It was explained in Hindi. 'My name is Om Prakash. I work as a security guard.' He spoke this much for the first time. The second night, he watched 10 easy daily sentences—'Good morning sir', 'How can I help you?', 'Please sign the register', 'Your cab is waiting', 'May I see your ID, please?'. These were all sentences for a security guard's job. The third night, he watched English words for good manners—'Welcome sir', 'Have a good day', 'Please wait, I will check', 'Thank you for visiting'. Now his nightly duty routine changed. 10 to 12, watch videos on English Seekho app. 12 to 2, practice with AI Coach. 2 to 4, try what he learned on people coming to the gate. 4 to 6, take a round of the society. He talked to the AI Coach daily, available 24 hours. He said, 'I have a corporate security supervisor interview, what will they ask?' AI Coach taught him—'I have 10 years of experience in security. I can manage visitor logs, coordinate with the admin team, and handle emergency situations. I am comfortable communicating in English with residents and guests.' Practiced line by line. Spoke wrong 500 times, corrected 500 times. It never said you are 55, you can't do it. The first week, he said to the delivery boy at the gate...]
Speaker A (Om Prakash): Good evening. Please sign here.
Speaker B (Narrator): Delivery boy ne dekha, smile ki. Doosre hafte society ke uncle aaye raat ko, Om Prakash ne bola... [The delivery boy looked and smiled. The second week, a society uncle came at night, Om Prakash said...]
Speaker A (Om Prakash): Good night, sir. Have a good sleep.
Speaker B (Narrator): Uncle ruk gaye, bole, 'Om Prakash, tune angrezi seekh li!' Ek mahine mein basic confidence aa gaya. Rohit ne bola... [The uncle stopped and said, 'Om Prakash, you learned English!' In one month, basic confidence came. Rohit said...]
Speaker E (Rohit): Uncle, ab corporate interview do. [Uncle, now give a corporate interview.]
Speaker B (Narrator): Ek tech park mein security supervisor ki vacancy thi, salary ₹22,000. Interview gaya. Interviewer... [There was a security supervisor vacancy in a tech park, salary ₹22,000. He went for the interview. The interviewer...]
Speaker D (Interviewer): Can you tell us about your experience?
Speaker A (Om Prakash): Sir, I have been working in security for 12 years. I am currently posted at a residential society in Gomti Nagar. I manage the night shift. I maintain the visitor log, handle deliveries, and ensure the safety of 80 families. I am comfortable speaking in English, and I can coordinate with your admin and facility team.
Speaker B (Narrator): Interviewer ne dekha, notes liye, bola... [The interviewer looked, took notes, and said...]
Speaker D (Interviewer): When can you join?
Speaker B (Narrator): Salary ₹22,000. Pehle ₹8,000 thi, teen guna! Teen mahine mein ₹66,000 extra aa gaye. 6 mahine mein ₹1,32,000. 10 mahine mein ₹2 lakh se zyada bach gaya. Beti ki shaadi ki tareekh tay hui. Om Prakash ne biwi se bola, '₹2 lakh ka intezaam ho gaya hai, kisi se maanga nahi, kisi ka ehsaan nahi.' Biwi ki aankhein bhar aayin khushi se. Shaadi hui, chhoti thi par izzat waali thi. Beti vidai par rote hue boli... [Salary ₹22,000. Earlier it was ₹8,000, three times! In three months, ₹66,000 extra came. In 6 months, ₹1,32,000. In 10 months, saved more than ₹2 lakhs. The daughter's wedding date was fixed. Om Prakash told his wife, '₹2 lakhs is arranged, didn't ask anyone, no favors.' His wife's eyes filled with joy. The wedding happened, it was small but respectable. The daughter said crying during farewell...]
Speaker F (Daughter): Papa, aapne kabhi nahi bolne diya ki humne kisi ke aage haath phailaya. [Papa, you never let anyone say we stretched our hands before anyone.]
Speaker B (Narrator): Om Prakash aaj bhi raat ko duty karta hai, par ab corporate park mein. Salary ₹22,000. Angrezi mein baat karta hai visitors se, admin se, management se. Wahi 8 ghante hain, par ab woh 8 ghante uski beti ki shaadi ka kharcha the, uske bete ki fees hain, aur uski khud ki izzat hain. Society ka Rohit ab bhi milta hai kabhi-kabhi. Rohit bola... [Om Prakash still does night duty today, but now in a corporate park. Salary ₹22,000. Speaks in English with visitors, admin, management. The same 8 hours, but now those 8 hours paid for his daughter's wedding, his son's fees, and his own self-respect. Rohit from the society still meets him sometimes. Rohit said...]
Speaker E (Rohit): Uncle, kaisa chal raha hai? [Uncle, how is it going?]
Speaker A (Om Prakash): Beta, tere wajah se chal raha hai. Toone us raat Seekho app ka naam liya tha, warna aaj bhi gaane sun raha hota! [Son, it's going because of you. You mentioned the Seekho app that night, otherwise I would still be listening to songs today!]
Speaker B (Narrator): English Seekho app download karo. General English show kholo. Hello se baat shuru karein, class start karein. AI Coach se roz practice karo. 8 ghante nahi hain toh 15 minute do, ek mahine mein fark dikhega. Angrezi nahi aati toh ₹8,000 ki naukri milti hai, angrezi aa gayi toh ₹22,000 ki. Fark sirf ek language ka hai. Toh language seekho, zindagi badal jayegi. [Download the English Seekho app. Open the General English show. Start talking with hello, start the class. Practice daily with the AI Coach. If you don't have 8 hours, give 15 minutes, you will see the difference in a month. If you don't know English, you get an ₹8,000 job, if you know English, a ₹22,000 one. The difference is just of a language. So learn the language, life will change.]
Speaker G (End-card Voiceover): Toh install button par click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]

summary: A 55-year-old night watchman earning a low salary reframes his empty night-shift hours to learn English using the English Seekho app. By practicing with the app's AI Coach, he successfully interviews for a corporate security supervisor role, tripling his income and funding his daughter's wedding. The ad encourages viewers to utilize their free time to learn English and upgrade their careers by downloading the app.
